    ```yaml
        where: Process_com_ext
        expression: Process_p <= Process_p_max_pu * (Process_p_nom_ext - Process_maintenance_pu * Process_maintenance_capacity)
        description: '`Process-com-ext-p-upper-cap` — a committed extendable process runs at most what is
          available of the chosen build, whatever its status'
      Process_com_mod_p_lower:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_p >= Process_p_min_pu * Process_p_nom_mod * (Process_status - Process_maintenance_pu
          * Process_maintenance_status)
        description: '`Process-com-mod-p-lower` — a committed modular process runs at least its minimum of
          one module, whether the build is fixed or a decision'
      Process_com_mod_p_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_p <= Process_p_max_pu * Process_p_nom_mod * (Process_status - Process_maintenance_pu
          * Process_maintenance_status)
        description: '`Process-com-mod-p-upper` — a committed modular process runs at most one module''s share,
          whether the build is fixed or a decision'
      Process_com_p_lower:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND NOT Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Process_p >= Process_p_min_pu * Process_p_nom * (Process_status - Process_maintenance_pu
          * Process_maintenance_status)
        description: '`Process-com-p-lower` — a committed process runs at least its minimum. Off, it runs
          at least nothing'
      Process_com_p_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND NOT Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Process_p <= Process_p_max_pu * Process_p_nom * (Process_status - Process_maintenance_pu
          * Process_maintenance_status)
        description: '`Process-com-p-upper` — a committed process runs at most what is available. Off, it
          runs at most nothing'
      Process_com_transition_shut_down:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed
        expression: Process_shut_down >= Process_previous_status - Process_status
        description: '`Process-com-transition-shut-down` — turning off is a stop, counted against the state
          the process carried into the snapshot'
      Process_com_transition_start_up:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed
        expression: Process_start_up >= Process_status - Process_previous_status
        description: '`Process-com-transition-start-up` — turning on is a start, counted against the state
          the process carried into the snapshot'
      Process_ext_p_nom_lower:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_active_asset
        expression: Process_p_nom_ext >= Process_p_nom_min
        description: '`Process-ext-p_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Process_ext_p_nom_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_active_asset AND Process_p_nom_max
        expression: Process_p_nom_ext <= Process_p_nom_max
        description: '`Process-ext-p_nom-upper` — the chosen build is at most its cap in every scenario. A
          cap of infinity is no row'
      Process_maint_event_count:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        where: Process_maintainable
        expression: sum(Process_maintenance_start, over=snapshot) == Process_maintenance_events
        description: '`Process-maint-event-count` — a maintainable process holds its number of maintenance
          events over the horizon'
      Process_maint_modstatus_lb:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_maintenance_status >= Process_status - Process_maintenance_modules * (1 - Process_maintenance)
        description: '`Process-maint-modstatus-lb` — in maintenance, every module on is on in maintenance'
      Process_maint_modstatus_le_maint:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_maintenance_status <= Process_maintenance_modules * Process_maintenance
        description: '`Process-maint-modstatus-le-maint` — out of maintenance, no module is on in maintenance.
          In it, at most its modules in maintenance'
      Process_maint_modstatus_le_status:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_maintenance_status <= Process_status
        description: '`Process-maint-modstatus-le-status` — the modules on in maintenance are at most the
          modules on'
      Process_maint_start_horizon:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_active AND Process_maintenance_start_blocked
        expression: Process_maintenance_start == 0
        description: '`Process-maint-start-horizon` — no event starts where it could not run its whole duration'
      Process_maint_status_lb:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_committed AND NOT Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_p_nom_mod
          > 0)
        expression: Process_maintenance_status >= Process_status + Process_maintenance - 1
        description: '`Process-maint-status-lb` — on and in maintenance, the status in maintenance is one'
      Process_maint_status_le_maint:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_committed AND NOT Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_p_nom_mod
          > 0)
        expression: Process_maintenance_status <= Process_maintenance
        description: '`Process-maint-status-le-maint` — out of maintenance, the status in maintenance is zero'
      Process_maint_status_le_status:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_committed AND NOT Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_p_nom_mod
          > 0)
        expression: Process_maintenance_status <= Process_status
        description: '`Process-maint-status-le-status` — the status in maintenance is at most the status'
      Process_maint_window:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_active
        expression: Process_maintenance == sum(Process_maintenance_start, over=start, by=Process_maintenance_cover[covered])
        description: '`Process-maint-window` — a process is in maintenance exactly where an event it started
          covers the snapshot. Two events do not overlap, since the maintenance status is at most one'
      Process_maintcap_lower_nommax:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maint_ext
        expression: Process_maintenance_capacity >= Process_p_nom_ext - Process_p_nom_max * (1 - Process_maintenance)
        description: '`Process-maintcap_lower_nommax` — in maintenance, the whole chosen build is taken off'
      Process_maintcap_lower_nommin:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maint_ext AND Process_p_nom_min > 0
        expression: Process_maintenance_capacity >= Process_p_nom_min * Process_maintenance
        description: '`Process-maintcap_lower_nommin` — in maintenance, at least the floor of the build is
          taken off'
      Process_maintcap_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maint_ext
        expression: Process_maintenance_capacity <= Process_p_nom_ext - Process_p_nom_min * (1 - Process_maintenance)
        description: '`Process-maintcap_upper` — the build taken off is at most the chosen build in maintenance,
          and at most the build less its floor out of it'
      Process_maintcap_upper_nommax:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maint_ext
        expression: Process_maintenance_capacity <= Process_p_nom_max * Process_maintenance
        description: '`Process-maintcap_upper_nommax` — out of maintenance, no build is taken off'
      Process_p_nom_modularity:
        dims: [process]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0 AND Process_active_asset
        expression: Process_p_nom_ext == Process_p_nom_mod * Process_n_mod
        description: '`Process-p_nom_modularity` — the chosen build is a whole number of modules'
      Process_shut_down_p_fixed_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND NOT (Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Process_shut_down <= Process_modules_installed
        description: '`Process-shut_down-p-fixed-upper` — a stop is at most the modules in place, an explicit
          row as PyPSA writes it. The bound is one where the build is not modular, and the fixed build''s
          whole count of modules where it is'
      Process_shut_down_p_nom_variable_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_shut_down <= Process_n_mod
        description: '`Process-shut_down-p_nom-variable-upper` — a modular process stops only where a module
          is built'
      Process_start_up_p_fixed_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND NOT (Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Process_start_up <= Process_modules_installed
        description: '`Process-start_up-p-fixed-upper` — a start is at most the modules in place, an explicit
          row as PyPSA writes it. The bound is one where the build is not modular, and the fixed build''s
          whole count of modules where it is'
      Process_start_up_p_nom_variable_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_start_up <= Process_n_mod
        description: '`Process-start_up-p_nom-variable-upper` — a modular process starts only where a module
          is built'
      Process_status_p_fixed_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND NOT (Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Process_status <= Process_modules_installed
        description: '`Process-status-p-fixed-upper` — a status is at most the modules in place, an explicit
          row as PyPSA writes it. The bound is one where the build is not modular, and the fixed build''s
          whole count of modules where it is'
      Process_status_p_nom_variable_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_status <= Process_n_mod
        description: '`Process-status-p_nom-variable-upper` — a modular process is on only where a module
          is built'
    expressions:
      Bus_injection:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        expression: ((Generator_injection + Link_injection) + Load_injection) + Process_injection
        description: what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each
          term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side
      Generator_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Generator_p_nom_ext * Generator_capital_cost * Generator_capital_weight)}
      Generator_commitment_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Generator_status * Generator_stand_by_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((Generator_start_up
          * Generator_start_up_cost) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator),
          over=snapshot) + sum(sum((Generator_shut_down * Generator_shut_down_cost) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot)'}
      Generator_injection: {expression: 'sum(Generator_sign * Generator_p, over=generator, by=Generator_bus[bus])'}
      Generator_maintenance_modules:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        description: 'how many modules of a modular committable generator can be on in maintenance: its build
          cap in modules where the build is extendable, and the modules installed where it is fixed (`constraints.py:588-594`)'
        cases:
          extendable: {when: Generator_p_nom_extendable, expression: Generator_p_nom_max / Generator_p_nom_mod}
        otherwise: Generator_modules_installed
      Generator_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum((Generator_running_cost * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Generator_p * Generator_p)
          * Generator_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot)'}
      Generator_previous_status:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the commitment state a generator carries into a snapshot. It is off at the first snapshot
          it is active in past the first of the horizon. PyPSA reads a status it did not build as off there
          (`constraints.py:391`). It is the state carried over otherwise
        cases:
          opening_late: {when: 'position(snapshot) > 0 AND NOT shift(Generator_active, along=snapshot, offset=1)',
            expression: '0'}
        otherwise: Generator_status_carried_over
      Generator_running_cost:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'what a generator''s output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve
          where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as
          PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`)'
        cases:
          curve: {when: Generator_marginal_cost_curve, expression: Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise}
        otherwise: Generator_p * Generator_marginal_cost
      Generator_status_carried_over:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'the state a generator carries over into a snapshot: the state it brought into the horizon
          at the first, the previous snapshot''s after that'
        cases:
          opening: {when: position(snapshot) == 0, expression: Generator_status_initial}
        otherwise: shift(Generator_status, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      Link_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Link_p_nom_ext * Link_capital_cost * Link_capital_weight)}
      Link_commitment_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Link_status * Link_stand_by_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((Link_start_up
          * Link_start_up_cost) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link), over=snapshot)
          + sum(sum((Link_shut_down * Link_shut_down_cost) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]),
          over=link), over=snapshot)'}
      Link_injection: {expression: '-sum(Link_p, over=link, by=Link_bus0[bus]) + sum(Link_output_arrival,
          over=link_output, by=Link_output_bus[bus])'}
      Link_maintenance_modules:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: 'how many modules of a modular committable link can be on in maintenance: its build cap
          in modules where the build is extendable, and the modules installed where it is fixed (`constraints.py:588-594`)'
        cases:
          extendable: {when: Link_p_nom_extendable, expression: Link_p_nom_max / Link_p_nom_mod}
        otherwise: Link_modules_installed
      Link_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Link_p * Link_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Link_p * Link_p) * Link_marginal_cost_quadratic)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link),
          over=snapshot)'}
      Link_output_arrival:
        dims: [link_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's
          `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot
          the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end.
          Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that
          does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Link_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]), along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency
      Link_previous_status:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the commitment state a link carries into a snapshot. It is off at the first snapshot
          it is active in past the first of the horizon. PyPSA reads a status it did not build as off there
          (`constraints.py:391`). It is the state carried over otherwise
        cases:
          opening_late: {when: 'position(snapshot) > 0 AND NOT shift(Link_active, along=snapshot, offset=1)',
            expression: '0'}
        otherwise: Link_status_carried_over
      Link_status_carried_over:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'the state a link carries over into a snapshot: the state it brought into the horizon
          at the first, the previous snapshot''s after that'
        cases:
          opening: {when: position(snapshot) == 0, expression: Link_status_initial}
        otherwise: shift(Link_status, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      Load_demand:
        dims: [load, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is
          active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`)
        cases:
          active: {when: Load_active, expression: Load_sign * Load_p_set}
        otherwise: '0'
      Load_injection: {expression: 'sum(Load_demand, over=load, by=Load_bus[bus])'}
      Process_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Process_p_nom_ext * Process_capital_cost * Process_capital_weight)}
      Process_commitment_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Process_status * Process_stand_by_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((Process_start_up
          * Process_start_up_cost) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process),
          over=snapshot) + sum(sum((Process_shut_down * Process_shut_down_cost) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot)'}
      Process_injection: {expression: 'sum(Process_output_arrival, over=process_output, by=Process_output_bus[bus])'}
      Process_maintenance_modules:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: 'how many modules of a modular committable process can be on in maintenance: its build
          cap in modules where the build is extendable, and the modules installed where it is fixed (`constraints.py:588-594`)'
        cases:
          extendable: {when: Process_p_nom_extendable, expression: Process_p_nom_max / Process_p_nom_mod}
        otherwise: Process_modules_installed
      Process_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Process_p * Process_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Process_p
          * Process_p) * Process_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot)'}
      Process_output_arrival:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by
          the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot
          the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's
          end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port
          that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Process_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])
              * Process_rate'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]), along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Process_rate
      Process_previous_status:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the commitment state a process carries into a snapshot. It is off at the first snapshot
          it is active in past the first of the horizon. PyPSA reads a status it did not build as off there
          (`constraints.py:391`). It is the state carried over otherwise
        cases:
          opening_late: {when: 'position(snapshot) > 0 AND NOT shift(Process_active, along=snapshot, offset=1)',
            expression: '0'}
        otherwise: Process_status_carried_over
      Process_status_carried_over:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'the state a process carries over into a snapshot: the state it brought into the horizon
          at the first, the previous snapshot''s after that'
        cases:
          opening: {when: position(snapshot) == 0, expression: Process_status_initial}
        otherwise: shift(Process_status, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      risk_weighted_opex: {expression: 'sum(scenario_weight * scenario_opex, over=scenario)'}
      scenario_opex:
        dims: [scenario]
        expression: ((((Generator_opex + Generator_commitment_opex) + Link_opex) + Link_commitment_opex) +
          Process_opex) + Process_commitment_opex
        description: 'what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot''s hours
          and its period, before the scenario''s own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted,
          as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`)'
      total_cost:
        dims: []
        expression: ((Generator_capex + Link_capex) + Process_capex) + risk_weighted_opex
        description: what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over
          the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail
    conditions:
      Generator_com_ext: {condition: Generator_committable AND Generator_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Generator_p_nom_mod
          > 0) AND Generator_active, description: 'a committable generator with an extendable, non-modular
          build that is active in the snapshot''s period. These are PyPSA''s `com-ext` rows, whose status
          is relaxed against the chosen build'}
      Generator_committed: {condition: Generator_committable AND Generator_active, description: 'a committable
          generator that is active in the snapshot''s period: every unit-commitment row''s set'}
      Generator_maint_ext: {condition: Generator_maintainable AND Generator_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Generator_committable
          AND Generator_p_nom_mod > 0) AND Generator_active, description: 'a maintainable generator with an
          extendable build that is active in the snapshot''s period, unless it is committable and modular.
          These are the maintenance rows against the chosen build'}
      Generator_marginal_cost_curve: {condition: 'count(Generator_marginal_cost_curve_p, over=breakpoint)
          > 0 AND Generator_active_asset', description: 'a generator that pays along a piecewise `marginal_cost`
          curve: one of PyPSA''s `active_assets` with curve data (`optimize.py:307`, `piecewise.py:230-257`)'}
      Link_com_ext: {condition: Link_committable AND Link_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Link_p_nom_mod > 0) AND
          Link_active, description: 'a committable link with an extendable, non-modular build that is active
          in the snapshot''s period. These are PyPSA''s `com-ext` rows, whose status is relaxed against the
          chosen build'}
      Link_committed: {condition: Link_committable AND Link_active, description: 'a committable link that
          is active in the snapshot''s period: every unit-commitment row''s set'}
      Link_maint_ext: {condition: Link_maintainable AND Link_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Link_committable AND
          Link_p_nom_mod > 0) AND Link_active, description: 'a maintainable link with an extendable build
          that is active in the snapshot''s period, unless it is committable and modular. These are the maintenance
          rows against the chosen build'}
      Process_com_ext: {condition: Process_committable AND Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_p_nom_mod
          > 0) AND Process_active, description: 'a committable process with an extendable, non-modular build
          that is active in the snapshot''s period. These are PyPSA''s `com-ext` rows, whose status is relaxed
          against the chosen build'}
      Process_committed: {condition: Process_committable AND Process_active, description: 'a committable process
          that is active in the snapshot''s period: every unit-commitment row''s set'}
      Process_maint_ext: {condition: Process_maintainable AND Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_committable
          AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0) AND Process_active, description: 'a maintainable process with an extendable
          build that is active in the snapshot''s period, unless it is committable and modular. These are
          the maintenance rows against the chosen build'}
    objective: {sense: minimize, expression: total_cost}
    ```

    The prep — every table the spec declares, from the network — and the solve:

    ```python
    from differential.pypsa.prep import relation, static, varying, weighting


    n = build()  # the network from the PyPSA tab

    sources = {
        'bus': pl.Series('bus', list(names(n.buses.index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String),
            **{
                dim: pl.Series(dim, list(names(n.static(component).index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String)
                for component, dim in DIM.items()
            },
            **scenarios(n),
            **periods(n, multi),
            **carriers(n, multi),
        'snapshot': pl.Series('snapshot', list(timesteps(n)), dtype=pl.Datetime('us')),
        'Generator_bus': relation(n, 'Generator', 'bus'),
        'Link_bus0': relation(n, 'Link', 'bus0'),
        'Load_bus': relation(n, 'Load', 'bus'),
        'Bus_attached': attached(n),
        'Generator_sign': per_component('Generator', first_scenario(n.generators['sign'])),
        'Load_active': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['active']), bool),
        'Load_p_set': varying(n, 'Load', 'p_set'),
        'Load_sign': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['sign'])),
        'snapshot_weightings_objective': weighting(n, 'objective'),
    }
    ```

    ```python
    """Rung 34: maintenance of committable units — a fixed, an extendable and a modular committable generator, link and process, each taken off for one event."""

    from __future__ import annotations

    import spine


    def build():
        """The spine plus an east bus and nine maintainable committable components, with a dear peaker to cover them."""
        n = spine.build()
        n.add('Bus', 'east')
        committable = {'committable': True, 'maintainable': True}
        n.add(
            'Generator',
            'unit',
            bus='north',
            p_nom=60,
            p_min_pu=0.3,
            marginal_cost=5,
            start_up_cost=10,
            maintenance_duration=2,
            **committable,
        )
        n.add(
            'Generator',
            'unit_ext',
            bus='south',
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            p_nom_min=5,
            p_nom_max=50,
            capital_cost=10,
            p_min_pu=0.2,
            marginal_cost=4,
            maintenance_duration=3,
            maintenance_pu=0.5,
            **committable,
        )
        n.add(
            'Generator',
            'unit_mod',
            bus='south',
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            p_nom_mod=10,
            p_nom_max=30,
            capital_cost=8,
            p_min_pu=0.5,
            marginal_cost=3,
            maintenance_duration=1,
            **committable,
        )
        for component, ports in (('Link', {}), ('Process', {'rate0': -1.25})):
            n.add(
                component,
                f'{component.lower()}_unit',
                bus0='north',
                bus1='east',
                p_nom=40,
                p_min_pu=0.2,
                marginal_cost=1,
                maintenance_duration=2,
                **ports,
                **committable,
            )
            n.add(
                component,
                f'{component.lower()}_ext',
                bus0='south',
                bus1='east',
                p_nom_extendable=True,
                p_nom_min=5,
                p_nom_max=30,
                capital_cost=5,
                p_min_pu=0.2,
                maintenance_duration=3,
                maintenance_pu=0.5,
                **ports,
                **committable,
            )
            n.add(
                component,
                f'{component.lower()}_mod',
                bus0='north',
                bus1='east',
                p_nom_extendable=True,
                p_nom_mod=10,
                p_nom_max=20,
                capital_cost=3,
                p_min_pu=0.5,
                maintenance_duration=1,
                **ports,
                **committable,
            )
        n.add('Generator', 'east_peak', bus='east', p_nom=100, marginal_cost=60)
        n.add('Load', 'east_load', bus='east', p_set=[50, 60, 40, 55])
        return n
    ```
